name: Standardized Image Preprocessing for ML
description:
You are a bioimage analyst preparing a dataset for a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Your goal is to transform a raw microscopy image into a standardized tensor format (256x256, inverted contrast, black background).

1. Open the 'Blobs (25K)' sample image: File > Open Samples > Blobs (25K).
2. Invert the image contrast (Edit > Invert) so objects appear bright on a dark background.
3. Resize the image (Image > Adjust > Size) to be exactly 128 pixels wide, maintaining the aspect ratio.
4. Pad the canvas (Image > Adjust > Canvas Size) to exactly 256x256 pixels. Keep the image Centered. Ensure the background color for the padding is Black (Value 0).
5. Save the result as a TIFF file to '~/ImageJ_Data/processed/blobs_ml_ready.tif'.
